autoContext: Validates python action. Covers: code param (Python 3 string executed in sandboxed exec with __builtins__={}), stdout capture (output captured via redirect_stdout), error return format ([error: msg] when exception raised), and empty/missing code returns None.

test_basic_code._comment: PARAM: code — Python 3 string. Executed in sandbox (no builtins). stdout is captured as the return value. Note: print() is unavailable in sandbox; any output must come from non-builtin mechanisms.
Assert-style check using only the statement keyword (assert works without builtins). A failing assert returns [error: AssertionError].

test_arithmetic._comment: Arithmetic and variable assignment work in the sandbox.

test_error_handling._comment: When code raises an exception, handler returns {id, data: '[error: <msg>]'} — not None. Workflow continues.

test_empty_code._comment: PARAM: code — empty string. Handler returns None (no result stored). Workflow continues.
Verify workflow is still running after empty code action.
